title: Earliest musical memory: godfather Kid Rene's band
summary: He recalls his godfather's band, Kid Rene, when he was about seven.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you remember the very first music you ever heard? When you were even a little kid, you know, barely able to walk? Maybe some people can't remember back that far, but... I mean, the first bands, do you remember any parades or bands or dance bands any time when you were a boy that you'd follow?
Well, I think I remember my godfather's band.
Who was that? Kid Rene. Oh, Kid Rene was your godfather. Yeah.
I think that was in the... Around the other 30's. I was real small then, I was seven years old. Yeah. I remember that.
